description.p: Magnetar is an open-source BitTorrent client with a modern interface. Open magnet links straight from your browser, choose which files to download, and organise torrents into categories with their own folders.

ul.li: File selection before downloading, with free-space check
Categories, moving files and automatic moving of completed downloads
Speed limits, alternative (turtle) limits and a speed schedule
Protocol encryption, VPN/IP binding and IP blocklists

screenshot.caption: Torrent list with speeds, categories and connection status

description.p: The Settings close button works again, and Connection settings now show whether peers can reach you, with a one-click firewall fix.
Large multi-file torrents that could stall at 0 bytes now download, public trackers are added by default for faster peer discovery, and settings save as you edit them.
Subtitle search in the built-in player, a one-click Windows Firewall allow action, much faster peer connections on fresh torrents, and several fixes.

Built-in search through your own indexers, play on your TV (DLNA), tags, per-torrent speed limits, actions and phone notifications when downloads finish, tracker status and peer bans, swarm health, disk protection, an incomplete-downloads folder, backup and restore, and HTTPS phone access.

Play while downloading, download queue, RSS auto-download, VPN kill switch, proxy support, torrent creation, import from other apps, phone access, file type icons, pausable updates, and faster, leaner transfers under speed limits.
Stricter path validation and log hardening.
File selection before downloading, categories, moving files, connection status, notifications, speed schedule and statistics.
Signed in-app updater and security hardening.
